# Vienna Imperials
> Foam dodgeball club in Vienna, Austria. Training, Imperials Social League and youth dodgeball.

## About
The Vienna Imperials are a foam dodgeball club in Vienna, Austria. Dodgeball is related to Völkerball, with its own rules. We play the modern foam variant under World Dodgeball Federation rules and offer weekly training, the Imperials Social League and youth training.

- [Homepage](https://www.imperialsdodgeball.com/): Dodgeball Wien — Vereinsinfo, Angebot, FAQ, Rangliste und Anmeldung

- [Youth Training](https://www.imperialsdodgeball.com/jugendtraining-wien): Dodgeball for ages 12–18, free trial training and school cup preparation
- [Partnerships](https://www.imperialsdodgeball.com/#partners): Sponsorship enquiries and the original nine-page sponsorship brochure (PDF)

- [Member Area](https://www.imperialsdodgeball.com/member): Mitgliederbereich mit Statistiken und Training-RSVP

## Contact
- Email: imperialsdodgeball@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/imperialsdodgeball/
- Season 2026/27: 14 September 2026–2 July 2027 inclusive. No training during Vienna school holidays or Austrian public holidays.
- Monday, 19:00–21:00: basic skill training, O-MS Max Winter Platz 12.
- Thursday, 18:00–21:00: Social League, Volksschule in der Krieau.
- Friday, 17:00–19:00: youth training (12–18), Am Kaisermühlendamm 2, 1220 Wien. All experience levels welcome; free trial training. Contact the club by email.
- Friday, 19:00–21:00: adult training, Am Kaisermühlendamm 2.
- Confirm available training dates and register in the member area. Public contact forms are enquiries, not training reservations. There is no automatic enrollment.

## Prices and Results
- Thursday Social League: €10 per session. Monday and Friday training: €5 per session.
- Semester pass: €100; annual pass: €180. Ask the club about pass coverage. myClubs check-in is available.
- The public league uses one season selector for current results and the frozen Season 1 archive (125 players), including tied Hall of Fame places.
- Current movement compares totals with the latest chronologically scored training; archived results are not given new movement calculations.
- Season 2 tiers use total season points including bonus points: Bronze from 0, Silver from 10, Gold from 25, Platinum from 45 and Diamond from 70. Private skill ratings are used for team balancing, not public tiers. Season 1 retains its archived tiers.
